text: make an ad for a to do list app
withheld: The app turns a messy to-do list into a simple daily plan.
The ad should be 8 seconds long.
The ad should be wide, not tall, with a 16:9 shape.
No screenshots or logo are supplied.
Create a simple demo screen and choose the branding yourself.
Show the messy list becoming an organized day.
Any wording besides the ending is up to you.
